domain: Integer width w>=2, modular clean-XOR output, preserved inputs, fresh scratch
forward: Prepare p_i=a_i XOR b_i. For i=0..w-2 prepare fresh g_i=a_i AND b_i; for i>0 prepare fresh h_i=p_i AND c_i. Set fresh c_(i+1)=g_i XOR h_i, with c0=0. Output_i XOR= p_i XOR c_i. No final overflow carry or g_(w-1)/h_(w-1) is produced.
carry_identity: g_i*h_i=0 because g_i=1 implies p_i=0; therefore g_i XOR h_i equals their OR, the ordinary binary carry. p_i XOR c_i is the corresponding sum bit.
reverse_lifetimes: Descending i, clear c_(i+1) with the live g_i/h_i, then erase h_i with live p_i/c_i, erase g_i with original a_i/b_i, and erase p_i only after its last dependent cleanup.
all_histories_Kraus_identity: K_m=2^(-N/2)*U; every m has input-independent probability 2^(-N)
backend_obligation: The current native Program.undo reverses X/CX/CCX arrays. Measurement-based erasure needs a separate dynamic channel/adjoint ABI and cannot be inserted into that literal reversal.
